issue.title: Bank Setup card inherits H1 typography in Live Preview
issue.description: At bob-plugins b8b7baf (also present before this epic at c5f5a1b), bankSetup Live Preview mounts its widget at the end of the bank H1 line (248c-plugin-bank-setup-hosts.js). styles.css defines .bob-property-card font-size from --bob-property-card-font-size, but .bob-bank-setup overrides that variable to 0.9em; em resolves against the H1 parent and weight remains inherited. The phase real-Obsidian contact sheet shows huge Setup, account summary, Edit, and YAML text beside a normal UI-small BANK badge; the standalone preview is normal. Lander inspected that image and confirmed the same CSS on the pre-epic source. Fix the bank root typography in a bounded way, preserving its existing H1-adjacent mount, keys, aria-label, and bank body behavior. Add a meaningful heading-parent versus ordinary-parent computed-style/layout check (light/dark and narrow width); rebuild, bump, and sync through the normal guard. Small because the inherited em/weight cause is identified; no title-slot redesign. This predates the badge and has no causal link to a current active epic.

task_type_fields.impact: Bank Setup is oversized and wraps disproportionately in Live Preview; the new species badge exposes the mismatch but did not cause it.
task_type_fields.repro: Open a fixture bank.md with # Bank in desktop Live Preview and inspect computed font-size/font-weight on .bob-bank-setup, toggle, collapsed line, Edit/YAML. Compare with Reading and a standalone bank card; see file:explicit:06ac5bda11561f50cbb70939.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-o6.4.1.3 note #5 and verified during collection-card landing: the existing bank widget inherits heading typography, producing oversized controls and extra wrapping.
